draft.subject: your new Columbus site
draft.body:
Hi Denise,

Saw Brookline is opening a new site in Columbus. A second building usually means orders and stock split across more spreadsheets.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Worth a look? If so, grab 15 minutes here: https://cal.example.com/nextron/intro
